## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

All 8 public FAILs, both PARTIALs, the cross-cutting findings and the checklist-maintenance list extracted; every framework defect re-verified live on `origin/main` (none already-fixed), zero duplicates.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `crud-permission-matrix` | an **allowed** create returns 500 while the row **is** written — `recomputeSummaries` issues the parent roll-up under the caller's context, then retries a non-transient `PERMISSION_DENIED` | #7673 | `domain:engine-core` |
| `owd-save-gate` | the ADR-0090 **D11** authoring gate never runs on any host-config deployment — keyed on `environmentId` instead of `authoringChannel`, the exact proxy-signal hazard #6710 retired for the sibling gate | #7674 | `domain:metadata` |
| `audit-log-browser` | 4 of 10 declared audit actions have **no writer anywhere** — 2 shipped list views and 2 dashboard widgets are permanently empty, and the console offers filters for rows the server never writes | #7675 | `domain:identity` |
| `permission-matrix-edit-loop` | the **field-level half of the permission matrix is dead for every object** — `MetadataClient.get()` returns the raw envelope, so `obj.fields` is always undefined | objectstack-ai/objectui#4271 | objectui |
| `record-share-grant-revoke` | package-seeded sharing rules are **unaddressable by name** — a strict org filter that `organization_id = null` rows cannot satisfy | #7676 | `domain:identity` |
| `suggested-binding-loop` (a) | the `isDefault` suggestion is never surfaced on stock — the plugin auto-binds at boot before any list call, so sync always takes `if (bound) continue` | #7677 | `domain:identity` |
| `suggested-binding-loop` (b) | unknown `?status` returns **200 EMPTY instead of 400** — the guard exists only on the dispatcher; the live REST route forwards it unvalidated | #7678 | `domain:cli` |
| `capability-declaration-lifecycle` (PARTIAL) | **no shipped resource enforces a package capability server-side** — there is no REST action-invoke route at all, so `requiredPermissions` on actions is client-side only | #7680 | `domain:cli` |
| `readonly-package-locks-studio` (PARTIAL) | the read-only refusal keys on the metadata **type's** overlay policy, not package writability; `ITEM_LOCKED` / `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` are ledgered but never emitted | #7682 | `domain:metadata` |
| Cross-cutting i/ii/iii | `verify --rls`'s green is not evidence; `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` overclaims `enforced`; the console permission editor is read-only by default on a surface the server would allow | #7685 | `domain:cli` |
| Checklist maintenance ×6 | dedupe the double-counted private defect + five stale item texts | #7687 | `domain:devx` |

The 8 PASS items produced no cards. The enforcement core measured genuinely strong — 124 access-matrix cells with zero withheld cell answering 2xx.

### The private finding

`rls-both-sides` c5 and `owd-sharing-matrix` c4 are the **same** defect, delivered privately as `FOLLOW-UPS.md` **D11**. Under the maintainer's 2026-08-11 instruction (verbatim: 「立一张私有修复卡」) its fix card is filed as **#7665** (`bug` + `security` + `pm:queue` + `domain:identity` + `target:v17`) — a by-id write not gated by record visibility, reproduced on three objects. Nothing about it is described in this public record or in the extracted cards above.

⚠️ **Naming collision worth stating once:** the **public** `owd-save-gate` card (#7674) concerns "ADR-0090 **D11**" — an ADR clause number for the external-OWD authoring gate. That is unrelated to the private FOLLOW-UPS **D11**. Two different things, same two characters.

### Two things the extraction added beyond the run

**#7685 is the highest-leverage card in this batch, and it is a tooling card.** `verify --rls` reports 0 HOLES while structurally unable to reach the by-id-write class — its probe holds no object grants, so every probe is masked by the object gate before record scope is tested, and 8 of 23 objects are skipped on a stock run. The private D11 defect hid in exactly that blind spot. Until this is fixed the tool's green is not evidence, which is why it is filed alongside the enforcement fix rather than behind it.

**#7678 is a dispatcher-vs-REST divergence in the *opposite* direction from the earlier ones.** The `/meta` cases were routes implemented on the dispatcher but never mounted on REST; here a **fix** landed on the dispatcher while the Hono route the server actually serves never got it. Cross-linked to #7526 with the argument that the route-ledger↔live-mount parity gate should cover **behaviour** divergence, not just mount presence.

Provenance: maintainer standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463/#7627.
